result.title: VoluCompose: Constructing Compact Volumetric Visual Representations for Medical Image Understanding
result.summary: Medical vision--language models can interpret volumetric images, but processing full volumes is costly because hundreds of slices produce long, redundant visual-token sequences. Existing compression methods often couple content selection with budget determination. We observe that neighboring slices share visual features and that attention concentration varies across visual encoders. We propose VoluCompose, a training-free, model-agnostic framework that separates what visual content to retain from how many tokens to allocate. Its hyperbolic token composition module groups contiguous slices into ordered support units and uses the Lorentz distance to account for feature magnitude and direction during token allocation, anchor selection, and refinement. Its capacity control module uses visual-encoder attention entropy to allocate more tokens when attention is more dispersed. We evaluate VoluCompose on two tasks across three datasets and four backbones. Across nine calibrated settings, VoluCompose attains the highest mean quality--retention hypervolume among the compared methods. It achieves a mean relative quality of 121.68\% against the uncompressed references while retaining 22.78% of visual tokens on average. Compression remains robust even at a 10% token budget. Across settings, the lowest ROUGE-L ratio to the uncompressed reference is 96.4\% for VoluCompose. The corresponding minima for the compression baselines range from 15.0% to 70.5%. Code is available at https://github.com/yezanting/VoluCompose.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VoluCompose，一个无需训练、模型无关的医学体数据视觉 token 压缩框架：将「保留哪些内容」与「分配多少 token」解耦，用双曲空间 Lorentz 距离把连续切片组合为有序支撑单元并指导 token 分配与锚点选择，同时依据视觉编码器注意力熵在注意力分散时分配更多 token，在约 22.78% token 预算下较好保持输出质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 其内容选择与预算分配分离、以注意力熵驱动 token 容量的做法，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与动态计算分配提供可核查线索，但不涉及 latent 推理状态的生成或使用。
